mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, email, display_name, password_hash, status, platform_role, last_login_at, updated_at FROM user_account WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT wm.workspace_id FROM workspace_member wm JOIN workspace w ON w.id = wm.workspace_id JOIN tenant t ON t.id = w.tenant_id WHERE wm.user_id = #{userId} AND w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND wm.role = 'OWNER' ORDER BY wm.joined_at ASC, wm.workspace_id ASC LIMIT 1
